census: SELECT category,count(*) AS n,sum(dur)/1e6 AS ms FROM slice GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
scopes: SELECT id,name,ts,dur,track_id,parent_id FROM slice WHERE category IN ('user_annotation','cpu_op') AND (name GLOB '*OwnerLookup*' OR name GLOB '*CompiledFunctionBackward*' OR name GLOB 'GFSDP::*' OR name GLOB 'task.profile_update*' OR name GLOB '*embedding_dense_backward*') ORDER BY ts
flows: SELECT count(*) AS endpoints,count(DISTINCT k.id) AS distinct_device,sum(CASE WHEN extract_arg(k.arg_set_id,'args.correlation')=extract_arg(h.arg_set_id,'args.correlation') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matching_correlation FROM slice k JOIN flow f ON f.slice_in=k.id JOIN slice h ON h.id=f.slice_out WHERE k.category IN ('kernel','gpu_memcpy','gpu_memset')
errors: SELECT name,value,severity FROM stats WHERE value<>0 AND (severity='error' OR name GLOB '*drop*')
device: SELECT k.id,k.name,k.ts,k.dur,k.category,extract_arg(k.arg_set_id,'args.stream') AS stream,h.id AS launch_id,h.ts AS launch_ts,h.name AS launch_name,(SELECT group_concat(a.id||':'||a.name,' > ') FROM ancestor_slice(h.id) a) AS ancestors,extract_arg(k.arg_set_id,'args.In msg nelems') AS input_elements,extract_arg(k.arg_set_id,'args.Out msg nelems') AS output_elements,extract_arg(k.arg_set_id,'args.dtype') AS dtype,extract_arg(k.arg_set_id,'args.Group size') AS group_size,extract_arg(k.arg_set_id,'args.Seq') AS sequence FROM slice k LEFT JOIN flow f ON f.slice_in=k.id LEFT JOIN slice h ON h.id=f.slice_out WHERE k.category IN ('kernel','gpu_memcpy','gpu_memset') ORDER BY k.ts
owner_host_waits: SELECT o.id AS owner_scope,o.name AS owner_name,s.name,count(*) AS n,sum(s.dur)/1e6 AS host_span_ms FROM slice o JOIN slice s ON s.track_id=o.track_id AND s.ts>=o.ts AND s.ts<o.ts+o.dur WHERE o.name IN ('_OwnerLookup','_OwnerLookupBackward') AND s.category IN ('cuda_runtime','cuda_driver') AND (s.name GLOB '*Synchronize*' OR s.name GLOB '*Memcpy*' OR s.name GLOB '*WaitEvent*') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3
